findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 1
Raise: Not done. The shortcut recognizes only `.factory/`, although Forge also identifies `plans/spotted.json`, `plans/spotted/`, roadmap entries and story documents as its records (`src/forge/templates/review.md:274–278`). A normal blocked review writes `plans/spotted/<item>.json` (`src/forge/spotted.py:234–246`). If main subsequently absorbs the product change, that spotted file remains alongside the state record, so close still invokes Autoreview instead of recording a clean review and printing the promised explanation. Include the recognized planning records in this classification and cover that case in the command test.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 1
Raise: Functional. If the first attempt writes unreadable findings and the retry fails without writing a report, the diagnostic output is lost. `_attempt` unlinks the output file before every attempt (`src/forge/review.py:1088`), and both attempts now share the persistent output path. Consequently, this existence check fails after the retry and close prints no saved-output path despite having received unreadable findings. Preserve the last available malformed report across retries; the new test currently repeats the malformed response on both attempts and misses this sequence.

why: Close sends a branch whose diff against main holds only Forge's own records to Autoreview, which fails twice with unreadable findings, and the message points at forge doctor
